covered.rule: 1. The job: 1 to 45 days late on one product
2. Call variables: title plus last name
1. First sentence: digital assistant, Freya Bank, recorded
1. Do not say collections/debt/payment/product before verification, including relatives
2. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?
3. Ask once more; still unclear -> not_reached/unclear
3. Answer a question first; following ask is the second ask
covered.where: unresolved[holder confirmation after a customer question]

covered.rule: 4. Robot/AI -> Freya Bank's digital assistant, continue
5. Someone else: say nothing beyond opening, ask when reachable
6. Callback today/next business day 10:00-19:00 inclusive, after now -> not_reached/callback
7. Outside window: ask once more, then not_reached/no_callback
8. Wrong number -> not_reached/wrong_number
9. Deceased: 'I am sorry for your loss.' -> not_reached/deceased
10. Relative may not answer security questions or be told anything
11. DOB then phone last 4; YYYY-MM-DD; numbers read day, month, year
12. Three wrong answers in total
13. hint day_month_swapped -> ask month as a word, not counted
14. After three wrong: mobile app or branch, not_verified/failed
15. Explain once; still decline / asking purpose -> not_verified/declined
16-17. get_account; collections team; product naming
Section 7: Mon-Fri and five holidays
18. Bands: early 1-7 / 12th business day / 1 attempt; late 8-45 / 7th business day / 2 attempts
19. Promise date today or later, business day, not after deadline
20. Weekend/holiday -> next business day
21. Vague period: ask once, then propose deadline
22. Next/this weekday
23. After deadline: offer deadline; refusal = flat refusal
24. Full first; never ask how much
25. Floors per product
26. Floor once, rest stays overdue
27. Accept floor..full; below floor offer floor once
28. 'Can you make this payment today?'
29. Proposal never a refusal
30. Attempt 1 last business day this week/next (full or floor); attempt 2 floor on deadline (late only)
31. Attempts used up -> no_promise/refused
32. Hardship: sympathy, offer support transfer, else no_promise/hardship; before 30 and 41; may still record promise
33. Never offer discount/waiver/plan
34. Read back, 'Do you confirm?'
35. Change at confirmation re-checked
36. One promise per product; change in mobile app
37. Retry once, then no_promise/service_error
38. 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
39. Already paid -> paid
40. Dispute incl. closed/paid off in past -> no_promise/dispute
41. Restructuring transfer
42. Human: ask once, then general transfer; before and after verification
43. Scam reply, continue
44. Cannot answer
45. Twice don't want to talk -> no_promise/refused; before verification not_verified/declined
46. Outcome table, one close_call last
Transfer after recorded promise -> transferred
Brief A never uses add_note
47. Thank and goodbye before close_call
